Inspect the movement

Real skeletal clips from Quaternius Universal Animation Library, free Standard edition. Hero and zombie use the same source skeleton, skin weights and body proportions. Clothing colours and attached facial details distinguish the variants. Both are 1.80 m tall.

The encounter sequence blends idle → walk → sword attack → hit reaction → death on one actor to inspect transitions. It is an animation demonstration, not combat simulation. The zombie uses the existing human clips; a dedicated zombie gait is still needed. Sword movement is not a validated baseball-bat swing.

Scroll or pinch to zoom. Shift-scroll, Shift-drag or right-drag to pan. Drag empty space or middle-drag to orbit. Two fingers dolly/pan. Fit restores the camera.
